gloss: knife skills; knife handling; knife technique

definitions.gloss: knife skills; knife handling; knife technique
definitions.explanation: A cook's skill at handling a kitchen knife — speed, precision, and control. Often used to praise the dexterity of a professional chef or a skilled home cook.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{包丁|ほうちょう}さばきが{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.english: My mother has excellent knife skills.

examples.japanese: {鮮|あざ}やかな{包丁|ほうちょう}さばきに{目|め}を{奪|うば}われた。
examples.english: I was transfixed by the brilliant knife work.

examples.japanese: プロの{料理人|りょうりにん}の{包丁|ほうちょう}さばきはまるで{踊|おど}っているようだった。
examples.english: The professional chef's knife handling was like a dance.

notes:
Compound of {包丁|ほうちょう} (kitchen knife) + さばき (handling, manipulation — from {捌|さば}く). Always positive in connotation; almost always used to praise someone's cutting skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包丁|ほうちょう}さばきが{上手|じょうず}: skilled with a knife
- {見事|みごと}な{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: impressive knife work
- {鮮|あざ}やかな{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: brilliant knife handling
- プロの{包丁|ほうちょう}さばき: professional-level knife skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手|て}さばき: hand technique — general dexterity, not just knife work
- {腕前|うでまえ}: skill level — broader; can apply to any craft
